questions.question: Can I carry forward unused home leave?
questions.answer: Unused home leave above 90 days is paid out at the basic salary rate at the end of the fiscal year in Asar. [1]

questions.question: Do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
questions.answer: Sick leave of more than 3 days in a row needs a doctor's certificate. [1]

questions.question: What happens if I submit a travel claim after 30 days?
questions.answer: Submit travel claims within 15 days of returning, with receipts, in the finance portal. [1] Claims submitted later than 30 days are not paid. [1]

questions.question: How often must passwords be changed?
questions.answer: Passwords must be at least 12 characters and are changed every 180 days. [1]

questions.question: How many people must enter the tunnel together?
questions.answer: A gas test must be done before entry, and at least two people must enter together. [1]

questions.question: When is the next loan instalment due?
questions.answer: The next loan instalment of Rs 10.5 crore is due on 15 Poush. [1]

questions.question: How much can the plant manager spend in an emergency?
questions.answer: Emergency purchases needed to restore generation can be made by the Plant Manager up to Rs 10 lakh and approved after the fact by the CFO within 7 days. [1]

questions.question: What is the design discharge of each unit?
questions.answer: The powerhouse has three horizontal Francis units of 8 MW each, rated at a net head of 182 m and a design discharge of 5.2 m³/s per unit. [1]

questions.question: How often is the runner sent for hard-coating repair?
questions.answer: Each runner is taken out for hard-coating repair every two years. [1]

questions.question: How much is the Dashain allowance?
questions.answer: Dashain allowance: one month's basic salary, paid before Ghatasthapana. [1] Site staff who work during Dashain or Tihar because the plant must run get a substitute day off and a festival duty allowance of Rs 1,500 per day worked. [2]

questions.question: What share of a department can be rated outstanding?
questions.answer: No more than 15% of a department can be rated 5. [1]

questions.question: When is the next board meeting?
questions.answer: The next board meeting will be held on 20 Ashwin 2082. [1]
